purpose: Teach: 振り込み/括弧/持ち物/鋭意/即刻/告示/第一線/積算

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 給与振り込みの日程を社員にお伝えしましょう
lines.en: Let's inform the staff about the payroll schedule.
lines.style: Clear, businesslike opener. Slight lean forward on the directive. Measured pace, confident. The tone of someone who's thought through this already.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料の括弧内の注記を統一しました
lines.en: Yes — I've standardized all the notes in the parentheses.
lines.style: Attentive and responsive. Quick clip on the affirmation. Matter-of-fact delivery of the accomplishment, no overselling. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の持ち物の安全管理を見直しましょう
lines.en: We should review the safety protocols for staff personal belongings.
lines.style: Calm, directive tone. Deliberate pacing on the core phrase. Professional but not cold — this is about care, not just compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。納期厳守で鋭意進めております
lines.en: Yes — I'm working on it with strict attention to the deadline.
lines.style: Earnest and reassuring. Light emphasis on the commitment. Steady tempo, no rush, no delay. The tone of someone keeping his word.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様の苦情には即刻ご回答しましょう
lines.en: Let's respond to any customer complaints immediately.
lines.style: Sharp, urgent without being panicked. Crisp articulation on 'immediately.' Forward-leaning energy. This matters and she knows they know it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。閉店時間の告示を店頭に貼りました
lines.en: Yes — I've posted the closing time notice at the front entrance.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact completion report. Brisk, efficient delivery. Small satisfaction in the practical detail. No flourish, just done.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界第一線の技術者を採用しましょう
lines.en: Let's bring on top-tier technical talent from the industry.
lines.style: Confident and aspirational. Slight rise on 'top-tier.' Steady, unhurried — she's speaking to something important. Vision, not panic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトの積算書をご確認ください
lines.en: Yes — please review the project cost estimate.
lines.style: Polite handoff. Respectful deference on the request without diminishment of his work. Quiet closure — the final word before stepping back.
